card.name: Words just before 'opening' or hole
card.fires_on: Small words like a, an, natural, small, nearby or created that come right before a body opening, hole, gap or similar space. The next word is likely 'opening' or a similar word.

modes.label: Body openings
modes.description: Articles or adjectives before a natural body opening or entry point.
modes.example: through a<< natural>> opening like the mouth

modes.label: Gaps and holes
modes.description: Articles before a gap, crevice, joint or empty space.
modes.example: used for filling<< an>> empty space, closing a joint

modes.label: Device windows
modes.description: Adjectives before a small window or surgical hole.
modes.example: visible only through the<< small>> round window at the end of the shield
